newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT-Indian GDRs rise on rally in Bombay.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT-Indian GDRs rise on rally in Bombay.

text.p: Indian global depository receipts closed higher Tuesday as local markets resumed their march upward.
Buying was concentrated in blue-chips, traders said, with broad-based geographic demand.
The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR index closed 0.74 points higher at 88.22, a 0.85 percent rise.
Bombay's benchmark index closed higher 62.23 points, or 1.55 percent, at 4,087.64.
Traders expect continued gains in the week, with foreign buying supporting the local market.
Telco shed 20 cents to $14.25/$15.00 and State Bank of India rose 41 cents to $26.25/$27.00.
The HSBC James Capel Korea GDR Index closed up 3.01 points, or 3.80 percent, to 82.14 points, a premium of 46.34 percent over the local market.
There was strong demand for blue chips, traders said.
The Capel Taiwan GDR Index rose 0.64 points, or 0.50 percent, to 127.03, representing a discount to the local market of 1.91 percent.
